body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage. Afterward yourself or an adjacent willing ally may move 1 unit around the target.

surges.html: On a hit, the target suffers -1 Fortitude against the next melee attack before your next turn.

rider.title: Authority - Order
rider.html: Spend this Authority when you or an ally within 3 units ends adjacent to the target: that creature becomes Rallied until your next turn.
